author: Carlos Martinez
title: 2023 YellaWood 500 at Talladega: Filmed From the Stands
description: I filmed the 2023 YellaWood 500 at Talladega from the grandstand: the pack, pit road and a 0.012-second photo finish.

sections.p: This is the 2023 YellaWood 500, a NASCAR Cup Series race at Talladega Superspeedway in Lincoln, Alabama, USA, on October 1, 2023. Talladega is a 2.66-mile superspeedway, the longest oval in NASCAR.
I was there, and I filmed it myself on my phone, most of it from the grandstand. None of the race footage here comes from TV.
The race ended in a photo finish. Ryan Blaney beat Kevin Harvick by 0.012 seconds, about a foot, and the win moved Blaney into the Round of 8.
It did not stop at the line. Harvick was disqualified in post-race inspection because the windshield fasteners were not secure. As a result, Austin Cindric got his first top-five of 2023.

list: Live pit stops on pit road.
A wreck seen from the stands.
A race scanner in my hand.

sections.p: Two of those go together. In one, the pack passes the stands. In the other, the same pack comes back 50 seconds later. Watch them back to back and you get a feel for how a pack moves around a 2.66-mile oval.
If watching the pack makes you want to try it, my closest guide is the Daytona superspeedway drafting guide. It is the best place on this site to start with superspeedway pack racing in iRacing.

faqs.q: Who won the 2023 YellaWood 500 at Talladega?
faqs.a: Ryan Blaney won. He beat Kevin Harvick by 0.012 seconds, about a foot, in a photo finish, and advanced to the Round of 8.
He was disqualified in post-race inspection because the windshield fasteners were not secure. Austin Cindric got his first top-five of 2023 as a result.
I did, on my phone, at Talladega Superspeedway on October 1, 2023, most of it from the grandstand.
